response.sql:
WITH nationality_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) as total_points,
    COUNT(*) as entry_count
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) as avg_count
  FROM nationality_stats
)
SELECT 
  ns.nationality,
  ns.total_points,
  ns.entry_count,
  ns.entry_count - ac.avg_count as difference_from_average
FROM nationality_stats ns
CROSS JOIN average_count ac
ORDER BY ns.total_points DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "constructor results" refers to the constructorResults table (not the driver-level results table or constructorStandings)

alternatives.interpretation: Aggregate points from the results table (driver-level) by constructor nationality instead, counting driver entries per nationality
